title: Brave New MTS
summary: Requires Multi-Team Support. A remote-only, character-free layer for MTS: your character never leaves its cell, and you build entirely through a construction-robot network seeded at each team's spawn around a large roboport. Place blueprints; the bots do the rest. No handcrafting, no hand-mining, no god mode. Starter bases on every team surface, including the Space Age planets.
